sources.title: States of Guernsey, Public holiday dates (2026 and 2027; the Public Holidays Ordinance, 2009)
sources.said: The statutory public holidays for 2026 are as follows: Thursday 1st January New Year's Day; Friday 3rd April Good Friday; Monday 6th April Easter Monday; Monday 4th May May Day bank holiday; Saturday 9th May Liberation Day; Monday 25th May Spring bank holiday; Monday 31st August Summer bank holiday; Friday 25th December Christmas Day; Monday 28th December Boxing Day (substitute day). 2027: Friday 1st January New Year's Day; Friday 26th March Good Friday; Monday 29th March Easter Monday; Monday 3th May May Day bank holiday; Sunday 9th May Liberation Day; Monday 31st May Spring bank holiday; Monday 30th August Summer bank holiday; Monday 27th December Christmas Day (substitute day); Tuesday 28th December Boxing Day (substitute day). All public holidays are prescribed by the Public Holidays Ordinance, 2009 as follows: New Year's Day, if a weekday; the 2nd January, in a year when New Year's Day falls on a Sunday; the 3rd January, in a year where New Year's Day falls on a Saturday; Easter Monday; the first Monday in May; the 9th May, Liberation Day; the last Monday in May; the last Monday in August; the 26th December, Boxing Day, if a weekday; the 27th December, in a year when Christmas Day or Boxing Day falls on a Sunday; the 28th December, in a year where Christmas Day or Boxing Day falls on a Saturday. "Weekday" does not include a Saturday. Christmas Day and Good Friday (and all Sundays) are customary la[w holidays].
